claims: OD-005 selects the exact ontology-powered non-expression seed: five fact subject kinds, RDF type and subclass reuse, sixteen Malleus predicates, five Malleus seed primitives, exact cardinalities, target rules, and whole-set invariants.

The complete neutral positive example contains 38 unique three-member facts in 6244 canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes, sha256 31db4d65...1ca74; its complete SlotUse binds the structurally derived 5fc2d89b...6452b URN.
Canonical graph revision 16 and all five Markdown projections have exact 1510-triple parity, 302 single-status subjects, and an acyclic 103-node, 105-edge dependsOn graph.

Metamodel validity is separate from source-to-fact completeness; LinkML and direct-fact conformance input converge without promoting a second public frontend, and applied defaults emit ordinary facts with separate provenance.

CC-D05 is zero-scope with candidate NONE, worker ledger NOT_STARTED, no selection, no stable public fact ID, and no implementation, ontology YAML, package, dependency, artifact, or downstream decision change.
limitations: This verifies governance and exact design bytes, not a shipped compiler, metamodel, validator, frontend, artifact, reader, diagnostic, or public API.
